GE Updated Fresh Food Evaporator Fan Motor (13.6V DC)

⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The bottom freezer works normally, but the upper French-door refrigerator section rises above 50°F (or you hear a high-pitched whirring noise that stops when you open the door).

Verified technical root cause: Failure of the 13.6V DC Fresh Food Evaporator Fan Motor hidden behind the interior deli drawer tower.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Hold down the door light switch with your finger inside the upper fridge compartment: if you do not feel cold air blowing from the center tower vents, the WR60X26866 fan has failed.
  2. Unplug the fridge, pull out the bottom crisper and deli drawers, remove the 4 screws holding the center climate tower cover, and plug in the updated sealed-bearing WR60X26866 fan motor.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Warm Fridge Compartment / Howling Fan Noise)

Does WR60X26866 replace the older WR60X26033 and WR60X10341 fans?
Yes! GE redesigned this fan under part number WR60X26866 with improved moisture sealing so condensation doesn't corrode the internal circuit board.
